description: ECHO explores the possibility of finding places on Earth that resemble environments on the Moon and Mars. By comparing their environmental conditions, it aims to reveal how our planet can help scientists better understand extraterrestrial worlds and prepare for future space exploration.
summary:
ECHO is a planetary exploration platform designed to identify potential visual similarities between landscapes on Earth and surfaces found on other planetary bodies, such as Mars and the Moon.
The platform connects planetary imagery with Earth landscape photographs and geographic information. Users can upload an image of a planetary surface, explore similar-looking environments on Earth, compare the images, and view potential locations on an interactive map.
ECHO aims to make the discovery of planetary analogues more accessible by bringing image exploration, comparison, and geographic discovery into one platform.
